item.title: Foolproof Rib Roast with Pan Gravy
item.description: Our Thanksgiving centerpiece this year. The method sounds wrong the first time you read it: an hour in the oven, then three hours with the oven off and the door shut. But it’s almost entirely hands-off, and it works.

item.title: Salmon Sushi Bake
item.description: Everything I love about a spicy salmon roll, without any of the rolling. Scoop it onto a sheet of seaweed and it disappears fast at a party.

item.title: Kerala Style Nadan Pork Fry (Ularthiyathu)
item.description: A classic Kerala-style dry pork roast in which the pork shines with just enough masala. Finger-licking good. My favorite way to eat it, though, is paired with a crispy dosa: a match made in culinary heaven.
